notes: The 70B variant uses GQA; smaller Llama 2 variants use MHA.
Each layer attends to a 4096-token window. A rolling cache can cap resident KV even though the model accepts longer sequences.
Sparse MoE changes weight compute and active parameters; it does not by itself reduce attention KV.
Llama 3 adopted GQA for both the 8B and 70B models.
The checkpoint uses YaRN metadata with original_max_position_embeddings=4096; the released model is evaluated up to 128K.
The base model was pretrained at 32K; the 128K instruction capability uses YaRN and long-context evaluation.
Open weights under the Mistral Research License; retained here as a major open-weight release.
Use the base checkpoint for the 128K architecture record; some instruct checkpoint revisions defaulted to 32K without a long-context configuration.
MLA keeps a compressed latent KV representation and a decoupled RoPE component.
Five 1024-token local layers are followed by one global layer.
Pretrained and post-trained at 256K; 10M is a supported length-generalization target. Three of every four layers use 8192-token chunked attention.
The official release table reports 128K; long-context data extended pretraining to 32K and the initial checkpoint config reports 40960.
The public report describes approximately 1T total parameters; 1.04T is used here.
The official report gives compression rates and a 1M-context relative KV result; use a model-specific formula rather than the ordinary GQA formula.
